name: cacentrp
description: Modern TypeScript bootstrap for legacy PowerBuilder CAC Enterprise (cacentrp.exe)

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/process && cp src/process/tranext-schemas.json dist/process/
scripts.test: tsx src/process/endofday.test.ts && tsx src/process/focus-cdr.test.ts && tsx src/process/glwalker.test.ts && tsx src/process/lspupload.test.ts
